descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Your train is waiting at Aurora Central. The signal turns green. Take power.

YOU ARE THE DRIVER
Grip the power and brake lever on the desk, or drive on the triggers. The cab displays are live: speed, the line limit, the next signal, the timetable and the distance to your stop. Sound the horn, work the doors and set back in reverse.

A 21 KM COAST LINE
Five stations from Aurora Central to Crystal Bay. Run out of the city, cross the long viaduct over Silver Lake, dive through the hill tunnel and come out among the pines. Other trains pass you on the opposite track.

STOP ON THE MARK
Each station has a stop board. Brake early, bring the nose to the board, open the doors and leave on time. Every run is scored on punctuality, stopping, comfort and rules, up to five stars, and stars earn you ranks from Trainee Driver to Chief Driver.

WALK THE TRAIN
Push the stick and stand up. Walk out of the cab, through the sliding glass doors and down the first-class aisle past the passengers. Sit in a window seat or the solo seat and watch the line go by.

RIDE MODE
Switch on the autopilot and the train drives itself, calling at every station on time. Ride up front or in first class.

THREE SERVICES, FOUR SKIES
The all-stations Coastline service, the non-stop Express at up to 300 km/h, or a Free Run with no timetable. Drive in clear daylight, at golden hour, at night or in the rain.

Play seated or standing. No account, no internet, no in-app purchases.
